snippet.title: Bob the Builder™: Fix It Fun! (Game Boy Color) - Full Game 1080p60 HD Walkthrough - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Includes the full game. Recorded with Elgato HD60, without commentary. 

If you enjoyed watching this video, please leave a like and subscribe! I would very much appreciate it!

Bob the Builder™: Fix It Fun! (Game Boy Color) playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf8CI9dzz_Q4quTZnGy4tg6L

🔨 Other Bob the Builder games on my channel 🔨
Bob the Builder: Can-Do Zoo (PC) video link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ThS7BO-joIE&t=635s&ab_channel=ToughGamingGuy
Bob the Builder: Can-Do Carnival (PC) video link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f38hQegJ2Ac&t=3s&ab_channel=ToughGamingGuy
Bob the Builder™: Can We Fix It? (PlayStation 1) 4K playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf_aor1ZuRyX2oVPevGCF2VA
Bob the Builder: Bob's Busy Day (V.Smile) video link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8UhdDlYPfk4&ab_channel=ToughGamingGuy
Bob the Builder: Festival of Fun (PlayStation 2) playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf_r3-JZca-WbGYb1-XtviNE

Summary: Bob and Wendy are inviting the Can-do Crew for a picnic beside a river. However, Bob and the machines have extra work to do around Bobsville before they can leave; Mrs. Potts' fence had been blown down, Mr. Bentley reported missing roof tiles on the Town Hall, Farmer Pickles noticed music sheets that have blown off the bandstand, Mr. Dixon's parcels have been scattered by Spud, and Pilchard has to be fed.

Release Date - ‎October 11, 2000
Genre - Platformer, Arcade
Platforms - Game Boy Color
Publisher - THQ, BBC Multimedia
Developer - Tiertex Design Studios

My Xbox gamertag: TGG Yari
My PlayStation gamertag: ToughGamingGuyYT
My Steam: ToughGamingGuy

Wanna see more of my fantastic walkthroughs? Give it a go: https://www.youtube.com/user/ToughGamingGuy
